Subject: Environment choices & kickoff plan for BrightWave trial

Hi Samira / Ops team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed path forward so we can lock the trial in and get your engineers started next week. High level: we recommend starting with a short hosted trial (fastest path to value) and then pivoting to a Dedicated sandbox or VPC trial only if you need specific isolation/data residency.

Trial goals & success criteria (please confirm / adjust):
- Functional: sample flows integrated with your QA prompts + reshaping (50–75 scored prompts)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms for 1k-token-ish request mix
- Throughput: support sustained 40–60 requests/min for parallel UX sessions
- Quality: average embed similarity / retrieval metrics above your baseline (we suggest 0.85 precision on the seeded eval set)
- Security: audit logs available, retain for 90 days for the trial (we can increase in Dedicated/VPC)

Recommended trial path (2-phase):
1) Week 0–2: Hosted trial on Redwood (fast onboarding, zero infra). We'll surface token/cost estimates and set up a shared sandbox API key scoped to the trial project.
2) Week 3–4: Conditional Dedicated sandbox / VPC prep if you require network controls or a BAA-backed setup (decision gate after the hosted run).

Owners / next steps (proposed):
- Ben Carter (SE): provision test model variants, share model-config and suggested batching parameters (ETA 48 hours).
- Laura Bennett (CS): run the seeded eval suite and produce pass/fail report for success criteria (ETA end of hosted week 2).
- Tessa Morgan (me): coordinate kickoff, SOW, and contract touchpoints; confirm dates and signoffs.

Kickoff windows: Thu May 21 or Mon May 24 — suggest 10:00 PT. Please confirm availability.

Attachments: SOW_v1.pdf (trial scope + pricing), onboarding-checklist.xlsx (ops checklist). Also attaching a lightweight model-config.yaml stub for Ben's note.

If the team is sensitive to PHI/HIPAA, flag that and we will route to Private/VPC + BAA discussions — Hosted is fine for de-identified test data.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this down.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks Tessa — useful summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we lock dates: 

1) Data residency / logs: for the trial we need to confirm where logs are stored and whether logs can be pushed to our S3 (or streamed). HIPAA is a hard constraint for production; for the trial we can use de‑identified data but we need audit log access. Can Redwood provide a 90-day export or stream?

2) BAAs / compliance: do you have a standard BAA or a HIPAA addendum we can review? If we move to Dedicated or VPC we'll expect that in place.

3) Cost: can you give a ballpark monthly for a small Dedicated sandbox (1 GPU, reserved) so we can flag budget quickly?

We are available Mon May 24 at 10:00 PT for the kickoff. Also can do Thu May 21 but prefer Mon.

— Samira

Subject: Re: Environment choices & kickoff plan for BrightWave trial — technical notes

Couple of technical follow-ups for the trial plan — copying the customer so they're in the loop.

- Hosted trial: fastest to provision. We'll issue scoped API keys tied to the "brightwave-trial" project and enable prefix caching for repeated QA prompts. Logs are stored in our audit system; we can support S3 export or push to your Splunk/Elastic via our log forwarder (requires an ops token). Retention for trial exports can be set to 90 days.

- Dedicated sandbox estimate (monthly, ballpark): $4,200/mo for a single A10G-equivalent node with 6TB memory profile and 100GB of NVMe cache (trial commit can be pro-rated). I'll attach a short model-config.yaml that shows the runtime variant we suggest (quantized 4-bit model tnt-llama-7b-q4f) and initial batching params. Expect token spend during hosted week to be ~ $250–$600 depending on load; Dedicated fixed cost is as above.

- Recommended initial runtime config for hosted trial:
  * Model: tnt-llama-7b-q4f (good balance of latency/quality)
  * Max tokens per request: 1024
  * Batch window: 20ms
  * Prefix/KV cache: enabled for repeated prompts

- Eval plan suggestions (Laura): we should run a seeded eval of 75 prompts split across retrieval + generation. I'll provide a small script to compute embedding drift vs your baseline.

Links: staging environment template (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/trial-onboarding

Attachment: model-config.yaml (stub)

Will be ready to provision the hosted sandbox once Samira confirms kickoff time and we get a signed SOW.

— Ben
